LESSON: MONEY

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement 2.4 Time By the end of the sub-strand,  Learners in pairs/groups to
Topic 2.5: Money

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Money. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-127.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 127]]

From your pupil's book (page 127)

MEASUREMENT MONEY Week 10 Lesson 2 Notes and coins Activity How much?

From your pupil's book (page 179)

MEASUREMENT MONEY Week 8 Lesson 2 Coins and notes Activity How much?

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-065.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 65]]

From your pupil's book (page 65)

TERM 1 MONEY Week 10 Lesson 4 Coins and Notes Activity Which coin or note

shilling coin 5 shillings coin 1 0 shillings coin 20 shillings coin

50 shillings note shillings coin 1 0 0 shillings note

5 6 _______________ _______________ _______________ 51

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Money means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Money.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Money
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
